1907-ozma-of-oz-06-the-heads-of-langwide.subject: Langwidere
1907-ozma-of-oz-06-the-heads-of-langwide.quote: Now I must explain to you that the Princess Langwidere had thirty heads--as many as there are days in the month.

1907-ozma-of-oz-06-the-heads-of-langwide.subject: Tiktok
1907-ozma-of-oz-06-the-heads-of-langwide.statement: Tiktok cannot feel sorrow or joy, no matter what happens.
1907-ozma-of-oz-06-the-heads-of-langwide.quote: I am only a ma-chine, and can-not feel sor-row or joy, no mat-ter what hap-pens.

1907-ozma-of-oz-06-the-heads-of-langwide.subject: Wheelers
1907-ozma-of-oz-06-the-heads-of-langwide.statement: Wheelers' wheels make them helpless to injure anyone.
1907-ozma-of-oz-06-the-heads-of-langwide.quote: Your wheels make you help-less to in-jure an-y one.

1907-ozma-of-oz-06-the-heads-of-langwide.subject: Tiktok
1907-ozma-of-oz-06-the-heads-of-langwide.statement: Tiktok struck the Wheeler over its head with the dinner-pail.
1907-ozma-of-oz-06-the-heads-of-langwide.quote: Tiktok swung the tin dinner-pail and struck the Wheeler a sharp blow over its head with the queer weapon.

1907-ozma-of-oz-06-the-heads-of-langwide.subject: Tiktok
1907-ozma-of-oz-06-the-heads-of-langwide.statement: Tiktok captured the Wheeler leader by his jacket.
1907-ozma-of-oz-06-the-heads-of-langwide.quote: Tiktok had fastened his copper fingers into the neck of the gorgeous jacket of his foe and held him fast.

1907-ozma-of-oz-06-the-heads-of-langwide.subject: Dorothy
1907-ozma-of-oz-06-the-heads-of-langwide.statement: Dorothy is locked in the North Tower.
1907-ozma-of-oz-06-the-heads-of-langwide.quote: they led Dorothy to a high tower at the north of the palace and locked her securely within.

1907-ozma-of-oz-06-the-heads-of-langwide.subject: Langwidere
1907-ozma-of-oz-06-the-heads-of-langwide.statement: Langwidere demanded to take Dorothy's head and give her No. 26 for it.
1907-ozma-of-oz-06-the-heads-of-langwide.quote: So I believe I'll take your head and give you No. 26 for it.

1907-ozma-of-oz-06-the-heads-of-langwide.subject: Tiktok
1907-ozma-of-oz-06-the-heads-of-langwide.statement: Tiktok knocked down seven of Langwidere's army.
1907-ozma-of-oz-06-the-heads-of-langwide.quote: Tiktok had knocked down seven of the army, who were sprawling in every direction upon the carpet, when suddenly the machine paused, with the dinner-pail raised for another blow, and remained perfectly motionless.

1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.subject: Ozma
1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.object: Ruler of the Land of Oz
1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.statement: Ozma is Ruler of the Land of Oz.
1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.quote: I am Ruler of the Land of Oz, and I am powerful enough to destroy all your kingdom, if I so wish.

1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.subject: desert
1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.statement: The sands of the desert destroy life on contact.
1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.quote: Behind the soldiers the green carpet rolled itself up again, so that there was always just enough of it for the procession to walk upon, in order that their feet might not come in contact with the deadly, life-destroying sands of the desert.

1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.subject: desert
1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.statement: No one has ever been able to cross the desert except Dorothy.
1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.quote: It was this desert, she thought, with much interest, that alone separated her from the wonderful Land of Oz, and she remembered sorrowfully that she had been told no one had ever been able to cross this dangerous waste but herself.

1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.subject: Scarecrow
1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.statement: Scarecrow rides astride Saw-Horse behind Ozma's chariot.
1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.quote: Following close behind the chariot Dorothy saw her old friend the Scarecrow, riding calmly astride a wooden Saw-Horse, which pranced and trotted as naturally as any meat horse could have done.

1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.subject: Tin Woodman
1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.statement: Tin Woodman marches on foot at the head of a company of twenty-seven soldiers.
1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.quote: The Tin Woodman was on foot, marching at the head of a company of twenty-seven soldiers, of whom some were lean and some fat, some short and some tall; but all the twenty-seven were dressed in handsome uniforms of various designs and colors, no two being alike in any respect.

1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.subject: Langwidere
1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.statement: Langwidere locked Dorothy up in her tower.
1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.quote: But first you must liberate another prisoner--the little girl you have locked up in your tower.

1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.subject: Nome King
1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.statement: Nome King is holding the Queen of Ev and her children prisoners.
1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.quote: Yet I did not come here to do harm, but rather to free the royal family of Ev from the thrall of the Nome King, the news having reached me that he is holding the Queen and her children prisoners.

1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.subject: Tiktok
1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.value: Smith & Tin-ker's Im-proved Com-bi-na-tion Steel Brains
1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.statement: Tiktok's brains are Smith & Tin-ker's Im-proved Com-bi-na-tion Steel Brains.
1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.quote: I am fit-ted with Smith & Tin-ker's Im-proved Com-bi-na-tion Steel Brains.

1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.subject: Wizard of Oz
1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.statement: Wizard of Oz gave Scarecrow his brains.
1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.quote: They were given to me by the great Wizard of Oz, and I didn't get a chance to examine them before he put them in.

1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.subject: Nanda
1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.quote: And the twenty-seven soldiers made such a noise and a clatter that the little maid Nanda ran away screaming to her mistress, whereupon the Princess Langwidere, roused to great anger by this rude invasion of her palace, came running into the drawing-room without any assistance whatever.

1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.subject: Ozma
1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.statement: Ozma re-entered the room leading Dorothy by the hand.
1907-ozma-of-oz-07-ozma-of-oz-to-the-res.quote: Just then Ozma re-entered the room, leading Dorothy by the hand and followed closely by the Princess Langwidere.

1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.subject: Dorothy
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.statement: Dorothy rushed into the embrace of the Scarecrow.
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.quote: The first thing Dorothy did was to rush into the embrace of the Scarecrow

1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.subject: Tin Woodman
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.statement: The Tin Woodman embraced Dorothy very gently.
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.quote: Then the Tin Woodman embraced her--very gently

1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.subject: Dorothy
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.statement: Dorothy wound up Tiktok's action with the key.
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.quote: Dorothy took the key to Tiktok from her pocket and wound up the machine man's action

1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.subject: Scarecrow
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.statement: The Scarecrow and the Tin Woodman thanked Tiktok for protecting Dorothy.
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.quote: both the Scarecrow and the Tin Woodman shook hands with the machine once more and thanked him for protecting their friend.

1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.subject: Billina
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.statement: Billina is a friend of Dorothy's.
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.quote: She's a yellow hen who is another friend of mine,

1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.subject: Langwidere
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.statement: Langwidere said Billina is in the chicken house in the back yard.
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.quote: She is in the chicken house, in the back yard,

1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.subject: Cowardly Lion
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.statement: The Hungry Tiger is a new friend of the Cowardly Lion.
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.quote: let me introduce to you a new friend of mine, the Hungry Tiger.

1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.subject: Dorothy
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.quote: In an instant Dorothy was hugging the huge Lion joyfully.

1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.subject: Hungry Tiger
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.statement: The Hungry Tiger refuses to eat living creatures because his conscience tells him it is wrong.
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.quote: But I've never eaten any, because my conscience tells me it is wrong.

1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.subject: Hungry Tiger
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.statement: It is the nature of tigers to be cruel and ferocious, and the Hungry Tiger acts against that nature by refusing to eat harmless living creatures.
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.quote: For it is the nature of tigers to be cruel and ferocious, and in refusing to eat harmless living creatures I am acting as no good tiger has ever before acted.

1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.subject: Billina
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.statement: Billina fought and defeated the speckled rooster in the chicken house.
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.quote: the girl saw Billina crouching upon the prostrate form of a speckled rooster.

1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.subject: Dorothy
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.statement: Dorothy unlatched the door to let Billina out of the chicken house.
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.quote: Come here, Billina, and I'll let you out; for Ozma of Oz is here, and has set us free.

1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.subject: Dorothy
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.statement: Dorothy introduced Billina to the Cowardly Lion and the Hungry Tiger.
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.quote: Soon they came to the Cowardly Lion and the Hungry Tiger to whom the girl introduced the Yellow Hen.

1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.subject: Tin Woodman
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.statement: The Tin Woodman's Army has eight Generals, six Colonels, seven Majors and five Captains, besides one private.
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.quote: I have in my Army eight Generals, six Colonels, seven Majors and five Captains, besides one private for them to command.

1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.subject: Ozma
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.statement: Ozma will hold a conference to decide how to liberate the royal family of Ev from long imprisonment.
1907-ozma-of-oz-08-the-hungry-tiger.md.quote: we will hold a solemn conference to decide the best manner of liberating the royal family of this fair Land of Ev from their long imprisonment.

1907-ozma-of-oz-09-the-royal-family-of-e.subject: Evoldo
1907-ozma-of-oz-09-the-royal-family-of-e.statement: Evoldo is the former King of Ev.
1907-ozma-of-oz-09-the-royal-family-of-e.quote: word came to our noble and illustrious Ruler, Ozma of Oz, that the wife and ten children--five boys and five girls--of the former King of Ev, by name Evoldo, have been enslaved by the Nome King and are held prisoners in his underground palace.

1907-ozma-of-oz-09-the-royal-family-of-e.subject: Nome King
1907-ozma-of-oz-09-the-royal-family-of-e.statement: The Nome King enslaved the wife and ten children of Evoldo and holds them prisoners in his underground palace.
1907-ozma-of-oz-09-the-royal-family-of-e.quote: word came to our noble and illustrious Ruler, Ozma of Oz, that the wife and ten children--five boys and five girls--of the former King of Ev, by name Evoldo, have been enslaved by the Nome King and are held prisoners in his underground palace.

1907-ozma-of-oz-09-the-royal-family-of-e.subject: Langwidere
1907-ozma-of-oz-09-the-royal-family-of-e.statement: Langwidere is the niece of Evoldo.
1907-ozma-of-oz-09-the-royal-family-of-e.quote: My uncle Evoldo was a very wicked man,

1907-ozma-of-oz-09-the-royal-family-of-e.subject: Evoldo
1907-ozma-of-oz-09-the-royal-family-of-e.statement: Evoldo sold his family to the Nome King in exchange for a long life.
1907-ozma-of-oz-09-the-royal-family-of-e.quote: But he sold them to the powerful Nome King in exchange for a long life, and afterward destroyed the life by jumping into the sea.

1907-ozma-of-oz-09-the-royal-family-of-e.subject: Evoldo
1907-ozma-of-oz-09-the-royal-family-of-e.statement: Evoldo jumped into the sea and drowned himself.
1907-ozma-of-oz-09-the-royal-family-of-e.quote: It was the King of Ev who did wrong, and when he re-al-ized what he had done he jumped in-to the sea and drowned him-self.

1907-ozma-of-oz-09-the-royal-family-of-e.subject: Nome King
1907-ozma-of-oz-09-the-royal-family-of-e.statement: The Nome King's full name is Roquat of the Rocks.
1907-ozma-of-oz-09-the-royal-family-of-e.quote: For the king, whose name is Roquat of the Rocks, owns a splendid palace underneath the great mountain which is at the north end of this kingdom, and he has transformed the queen and her children into ornaments and bric-a-brac with which to decorate his rooms.

1907-ozma-of-oz-09-the-royal-family-of-e.subject: Nome King
1907-ozma-of-oz-09-the-royal-family-of-e.statement: The Nome King transformed the queen and her children into ornaments and bric-a-brac to decorate his rooms.
1907-ozma-of-oz-09-the-royal-family-of-e.quote: For the king, whose name is Roquat of the Rocks, owns a splendid palace underneath the great mountain which is at the north end of this kingdom, and he has transformed the queen and her children into ornaments and bric-a-brac with which to decorate his rooms.

1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.subject: Billina
1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.statement: Billina lays an egg every morning.
1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.quote: Yes; she lays one every morning, about this time; and it's quite fresh,

1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.subject: Scarecrow
1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.statement: Scarecrow keeps Billina's egg in his jacket pocket for a souvenir.
1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.quote: So he left it in his pocket.

1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.subject: Iron Giant
1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.statement: The iron giant was made for the Nome King by Smith & Tinker.
1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.quote: He was made for the Nome King by Smith & Tin-ker, who made me, and his du-ty is to keep folks from find-ing the un-der-ground pal-ace.

1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.subject: Iron Giant
1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.statement: The iron giant's duty is to keep folks from finding the underground palace.
1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.quote: his du-ty is to keep folks from find-ing the un-der-ground pal-ace.

1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.subject: Iron Giant
1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.statement: Only the Nome King, who has the key, can stop the iron giant's machinery.
1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.quote: On-ly the Nome King, who has the key, can do that,

1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.subject: Iron Giant
1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.statement: The iron giant is only made to pound the road and has no thinking or speaking attachment.
1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.quote: he is on-ly made to pound the road, and has no think-ing or speak-ing at-tach-ment.

1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.subject: Tiktok
1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.statement: Tiktok was made by Smith & Tinker.

1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.subject: Ozma
1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.statement: Ozma uses the magic carpet to carry the cavalcade over the gulf.
1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.quote: At once it became the magic carpet, and unrolled itself far enough for all the cavalcade to walk upon.

1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.subject: Cowardly Lion
1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.statement: The Cowardly Lion carries Ozma under the hammer to the other side.
1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.quote: he made a sudden leap straight between the iron giant's legs, and before the mallet struck the ground again the Lion and Ozma were safe on the other side.

1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.subject: Hungry Tiger
1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.statement: The Hungry Tiger carries Dorothy under the hammer to safety.
1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.quote: He made the leap straight and true as an arrow from a bow, and ere Dorothy realized it she was out of danger and standing by Ozma's side.

1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.subject: Saw-Horse
1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.statement: The Saw-Horse has both ears broken off by the hammer.
1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.quote: both his ears were broken off and he would be unable to hear a sound until some new ones were made for him.

1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.subject: Saw-Horse
1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.statement: The Saw-Horse cracks his left knee.
1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.quote: Also his left knee was cracked, and had to be bound up with a string.

1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.subject: Scarecrow
1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.statement: Scarecrow has his left foot smashed by the hammer while rescuing the Saw-Horse.
1907-ozma-of-oz-10-the-giant-with-the-ha.quote: The Scarecrow dashed in to rescue his Sawhorse, and had his left foot smashed by the hammer before he could pull the creature out of danger.

1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.subject: Ozma
1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.object: ruler of the Land of Oz
1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.statement: Ozma is the ruler of the Land of Oz.
1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.quote: I am the ruler of the Land of Oz,

1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.subject: Nomes
1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.quote: They are rock fair-ies, and serve the Nome King,

1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.subject: Nomes
1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.quote: They are rock fair-ies, and serve the Nome King,

1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.subject: Dorothy
1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.quote: I'm only a little girl from Kansas, and we've got more dignity at home than we know what to do with.

1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.subject: Nome King
1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.statement: The Nome King transformed the Queen of Ev and her children into articles of ornament and bric-a-brac.
1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.quote: I transformed them all into articles of ornament and bric-a-brac and scattered them around the various rooms of my palace.

1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.subject: Evoldo
1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.statement: The King of Ev sold his family to the Nome King.
1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.quote: They are not my prisoners, but my slaves, whom I purchased from the King of Ev.

1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.subject: Evoldo
1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.statement: The King of Ev jumped into the sea and was drowned.
1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.quote: He jumped into the sea and was drowned.

1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.subject: Ozma
1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.statement: Ozma demanded that the Nome King appear to them.
1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.quote: I demand that the Nome King appear to us!

1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.subject: Dorothy
1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.statement: Dorothy pleaded with the Nome King to come and see them.
1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.quote: PLEASE Mr. Nome King, come here and see us.

1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.subject: Tin Woodman
1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.statement: The Tin Woodman threatened to have Ozma reduce the twenty-six officers to privates and make the private their general.
1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.quote: And if you try to run away again I will have her reduce all the twenty-six officers to privates, and make the private your general.

1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.subject: Cowardly Lion
1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.statement: The Cowardly Lion tried to spring upon the Nome King but could not approach the throne.
1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.quote: The Lion crouched low and tried to spring upon the Nome King; but he hopped only a little way into the air and came down again in the same place, not being able to approach the throne by even an inch.

1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.subject: Ozma
1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.statement: Ozma led the way hand in hand with Dorothy through the arched doorway into the long passage.
1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.quote: So Ozma led the way, hand in hand with Dorothy, and they passed through the arched doorway of rock and entered a long passage which was lighted by jewels set in the walls and having lamps behind them.

1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.subject: Nome King
1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.statement: Ozma may touch eleven different objects saying 'Ev,' and any that are the Queen of Ev or her children will be restored and may leave.
1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.quote: Then you shall have permission to touch eleven different objects, pronouncing at the time the word 'Ev,' and if any one of them, or more than one, proves to be the transformation of the Queen of Ev or any of her ten children, then they will instantly be restored to their true forms and may leave my palace and my kingdom in your company, without any objection whatever.

1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.subject: Nome King
1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.statement: If none of the eleven touched objects is the royal family of Ev, Ozma will herself become enchanted into bric-a-brac or an ornament.
1907-ozma-of-oz-11-the-nome-king.md.quote: If none of the eleven objects you touch proves to be the transformation of any of the royal family of Ev, then, instead of freeing them, you will yourself become enchanted, and transformed into an article of bric-a-brac or an ornament.

1907-ozma-of-oz-12-the-eleven-guesses.md.subject: Ozma
1907-ozma-of-oz-12-the-eleven-guesses.md.statement: Ozma accepts the Nome King's offer and goes into the royal palace.
1907-ozma-of-oz-12-the-eleven-guesses.md.quote: Therefore I will accept the Nome King's offer, and go at once into the royal palace.

1907-ozma-of-oz-12-the-eleven-guesses.md.subject: Dorothy
1907-ozma-of-oz-12-the-eleven-guesses.md.statement: Dorothy warns Ozma not to accept the Nome King's condition.

1907-ozma-of-oz-12-the-eleven-guesses.md.subject: Nome King
1907-ozma-of-oz-12-the-eleven-guesses.md.statement: The Nome King opens an entrance in the cave wall by waving his hand.
1907-ozma-of-oz-12-the-eleven-guesses.md.quote: He approached a wall of the cave and waved his hand.

1907-ozma-of-oz-12-the-eleven-guesses.md.subject: Ozma
1907-ozma-of-oz-12-the-eleven-guesses.md.statement: Ozma touches the silver candelabra and says Ev as a guess.
1907-ozma-of-oz-12-the-eleven-guesses.md.quote: So she touched it and uttered aloud the word "Ev," as the Nome King had instructed her to do when she guessed.

1907-ozma-of-oz-12-the-eleven-guesses.md.subject: Ozma
1907-ozma-of-oz-12-the-eleven-guesses.md.value: pretty grasshopper formed from a single emerald
1907-ozma-of-oz-12-the-eleven-guesses.md.statement: Ozma's ornament form is a pretty grasshopper formed from a single emerald.
1907-ozma-of-oz-12-the-eleven-guesses.md.quote: For upon the edge of the table rested a pretty grasshopper, that seemed to have been formed from a single emerald.

1907-ozma-of-oz-12-the-eleven-guesses.md.subject: Nome King
1907-ozma-of-oz-12-the-eleven-guesses.md.statement: There are now twelve persons transformed into ornaments, so the next guesser gets twelve guesses.
1907-ozma-of-oz-12-the-eleven-guesses.md.quote: The next may have twelve guesses, instead of eleven, for there are now twelve persons transformed into ornaments.

1907-ozma-of-oz-12-the-eleven-guesses.md.subject: Dorothy
1907-ozma-of-oz-12-the-eleven-guesses.md.statement: Dorothy volunteers to go next into the palace.

1907-ozma-of-oz-12-the-eleven-guesses.md.subject: Tin Woodman
1907-ozma-of-oz-12-the-eleven-guesses.md.statement: The Tin Woodman follows Ozma to attempt her rescue.
1907-ozma-of-oz-12-the-eleven-guesses.md.quote: As commander of Ozma's army, it is my privilege to follow her and attempt her rescue.

1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..subject: Nome King
1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..statement: The Nome King returned to his throne and relighted his pipe.
1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..quote: In a moment the King returned to his throne and relighted his pipe,

1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..subject: Nome King
1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..statement: The Nome King suddenly began laughing.
1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..quote: Suddenly the Nome King began laughing.

1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..subject: Ozma
1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..statement: Ozma has become an ornament in the Nome King's palace.
1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..quote: she was now an ornament in the Nome King's palace--a dreadful, creepy place in spite of all its magnificence.

1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..subject: Tin Woodman
1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..statement: The Tin Woodman has become an ornament in the Nome King's palace.
1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..quote: your friend, the Tin Woodman, has become the funniest thing you can imagine,

1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..subject: Nome King
1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..statement: The Nome King escorted the general into the palace.
1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..quote: So the Nome King escorted him into the palace, and again returned to await the result.

1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..subject: Dorothy
1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..statement: Dorothy ate several cakes and found them good.
1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..quote: so she ate several cakes and found them good,

1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..subject: Cowardly Lion
1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..statement: The Cowardly Lion had gone to sleep at one side of the cave.
1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..quote: having also eaten some of the cakes, had gone to sleep at one side of the cave,

1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..subject: Hungry Tiger
1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..statement: The Hungry Tiger had gone to sleep at one side of the cave.
1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..quote: having also eaten some of the cakes, had gone to sleep at one side of the cave,

1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..subject: Billina
1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..statement: Billina crept into a hollow underneath the King's rocky throne unnoticed.
1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..quote: Presently the hen espied a hollow underneath the King's rocky throne, and crept into it unnoticed.

1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..subject: Dorothy
1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..statement: The Chief Steward led Dorothy into a long hall with sleeping rooms.
1907-ozma-of-oz-13-the-nome-king-laughs..quote: the Chief Steward led Dorothy through another doorway into a long hall, from which several plain but comfortable sleeping rooms opened.

1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.subject: Queen of Ev
1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.statement: The Queen of Ev and her family are purple ornaments.
1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.quote: How could they know that the Queen of Ev and her family are all ornaments of a royal purple color?

1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.subject: Nome King
1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.statement: The Nome King transformed the people from Oz into green ornaments.
1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.quote: and it is still more foolish of you to transform all those people from Oz into green ornaments.

1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.subject: magic belt
1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.statement: The magic belt enables the Nome King to work all his transformations and gives him much other power.
1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.quote: If I wore the magic belt which enables you to work all your transformations, and gives you so much other power, I am sure I would make a much wiser and better King than you are.

1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.subject: Tiktok
1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.statement: Tiktok touched a yellow glass vase and said Ev.
1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.quote: So Tiktok touched a yellow glass vase that had daisies painted on one side, and he spoke at the same time the word "Ev."

1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.subject: Dorothy
1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.statement: Dorothy wound up Tiktok's action and speech and thoughts.
1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.quote: she hastened to wind up the machine man's action and speech and thoughts.

1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.subject: Dorothy
1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.statement: Dorothy touched an alabaster bowl and said Ev.
1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.quote: Timidly she touched an alabaster bowl and said: "Ev."

1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.subject: Dorothy
1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.statement: Dorothy freed Evring by touching the purple kitten and saying Ev.
1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.quote: Next she touched the image of a purple kitten that stood on the corner of a mantel, and as she pronounced the word "Ev" the kitten disappeared, and a pretty, fair-haired boy stood beside her.

1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.subject: Evring
1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.quote: I am a Prince of Ev, and my name is Evring,

1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.subject: Evoldo
1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.statement: Evoldo sold the Queen of Ev and her children to the Nome King.
1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.quote: But my father, the King, sold my mother and all her children to the cruel ruler of the Nomes, and after that I remember nothing at all.

1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.subject: Hungry Tiger
1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.statement: The Hungry Tiger's conscience would not allow him to eat a fat baby.
1907-ozma-of-oz-14-dorothy-tries-to-be-b.quote: my conscience would not allow me to eat it.

1907-ozma-of-oz-15-billina-frightens-the.subject: Tiktok
1907-ozma-of-oz-15-billina-frightens-the.quote: for he has now become a very neat ornament.

1907-ozma-of-oz-15-billina-frightens-the.subject: Dorothy
1907-ozma-of-oz-15-billina-frightens-the.statement: Dorothy made one correct guess and broke one of the Nome King's enchantments.
1907-ozma-of-oz-15-billina-frightens-the.quote: She has made one guess that is right, and broken one of my neatest enchantments.

1907-ozma-of-oz-15-billina-frightens-the.subject: Scarecrow
1907-ozma-of-oz-15-billina-frightens-the.statement: Scarecrow became a solid gold card-receiver.
1907-ozma-of-oz-15-billina-frightens-the.quote: So he became a solid gold card-receiver, and the beautiful but terrible palace awaited its next visitor.

1907-ozma-of-oz-15-billina-frightens-the.subject: Eggs
1907-ozma-of-oz-15-billina-frightens-the.statement: Eggs are rank poison in the underground kingdom and Nomes can't bear them around.
1907-ozma-of-oz-15-billina-frightens-the.quote: Here, in my underground kingdom, they are rank poison, as I said, and we Nomes can't bear them around.

1907-ozma-of-oz-15-billina-frightens-the.subject: Scarecrow
1907-ozma-of-oz-15-billina-frightens-the.statement: Scarecrow placed Billina's egg in another pocket of his jacket.
1907-ozma-of-oz-15-billina-frightens-the.quote: He knelt down and reached underneath the throne and found the egg, which he placed in another pocket of his jacket, fearing that if both eggs were in one pocket they would knock together and get broken.

1907-ozma-of-oz-15-billina-frightens-the.subject: Nome King
1907-ozma-of-oz-15-billina-frightens-the.statement: Nome King promised Billina she may enter the palace and guess.

1907-ozma-of-oz-15-billina-frightens-the.subject: Billina
1907-ozma-of-oz-15-billina-frightens-the.statement: Billina marched through the entrance into the enchanted palace.
1907-ozma-of-oz-15-billina-frightens-the.quote: Then Billina gave several loud "cluck-clucks" that seemed to make the fat little King MORE nervous than ever, and marched through the entrance into the enchanted palace.

1907-ozma-of-oz-15-billina-frightens-the.subject: Scarecrow
1907-ozma-of-oz-15-billina-frightens-the.statement: Scarecrow welcomed Dorothy with a close embrace.
1907-ozma-of-oz-15-billina-frightens-the.quote: The Scarecrow welcomed the girl with a close embrace, and he would have embraced Evring, too, in his delight.

1907-ozma-of-oz-15-billina-frightens-the.subject: Billina
1907-ozma-of-oz-15-billina-frightens-the.statement: Billina can speak the word 'Ev' plainly.
1907-ozma-of-oz-15-billina-frightens-the.quote: and I can speak the word 'Ev' as plainly as anyone.

1907-ozma-of-oz-15-billina-frightens-the.subject: Dorothy
1907-ozma-of-oz-15-billina-frightens-the.quote: the one good guess the Kansas girl made.

1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.subject: Billina
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.statement: Billina's rightful name is Bill.
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.quote: Why, my name's Bill, by rights,

1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.subject: Queen of Ev
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.statement: The Queen of Ev is the mother of nine children.
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.quote: where are my children?

1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.subject: Evanna
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.statement: Evanna is a child of the Queen of Ev.
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.quote: my own Evanna!

1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.subject: Evrose
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.statement: Evrose is a child of the Queen of Ev.
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.quote: whom the Queen addressed as Evrose,

1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.subject: Evardo
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.statement: Evardo is a child of the Queen of Ev.
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.quote: afterwards a boy named Evardo,

1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.subject: Evardo
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.statement: Evardo is the older brother of Evring.
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.quote: who was older than his brother Evring.

1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.subject: Evardo
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.statement: Evardo as eldest will inherit his father's throne and be crowned King of Ev.
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.quote: would inherit his father's throne and be crowned King of Ev when he returned to his own country.

1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.subject: Billina
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.statement: Billina disenchanted the purple footstool into the Queen of Ev by saying Ev.
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.quote: She placed a claw upon this and said "Ev," and at once the footstool vanished and a lovely lady, tall and slender and most beautifully robed, stood before her.

1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.subject: Billina
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.statement: Billina pounced on the green grasshopper that was Ozma and snapped it up before dropping it.
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.quote: instantly Billina pounced upon it and snapped it up in her sharp bill.

1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.subject: Billina
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.statement: Billina disenchanted a purple ornament into Evanna.
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.quote: the hen broke the Nome King's enchantment and a sweet-faced girl, whose golden hair fell in a cloud over her shoulders, stood beside them.

1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.subject: Billina
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.statement: Billina restored all of the royal family of Ev to their proper forms.
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.quote: Billina, having restored all of the royal family of Ev to their proper forms, now began to select the green ornaments which were the transformations of the people of Oz.

1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.subject: Nome King
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.statement: Green ornaments are the transformations of the people of Oz.
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.quote: now began to select the green ornaments which were the transformations of the people of Oz.

1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.subject: Billina
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.statement: Billina restored Ozma from the green grasshopper ornament.
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.quote: Mayhap, my gentle friend, it is the grasshopper whom you seek.

1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.subject: Scarecrow
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.statement: The Scarecrow's transformation is a solid gold ornament.
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.quote: The Scarecrow is solid gold, and so is Tiktok;

1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.subject: Tiktok
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.statement: Tiktok's transformation is a solid gold ornament.
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.quote: The Scarecrow is solid gold, and so is Tiktok;

1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.subject: Tin Woodman
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.statement: The Tin Woodman was transformed into something funny.
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.quote: I don't exactly know what the Tin Woodman is, because the Nome King said he had been transformed into something funny.

1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.subject: Ozma
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.statement: Ozma helped restore the Scarecrow from a shining gold ornament.
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.quote: soon the Scarecrow and the machine man, being ornaments of shining gold, were discovered and restored to their accustomed forms.

1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.subject: Tiktok
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.statement: Tiktok was made by Smith and Tinker.
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.quote: it is Smith & Tin-ker's fault if they some-times go wrong or do not work prop-er-ly.

1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.subject: Nome King
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.statement: The Nome King filled the domed cavern with mail-clad warriors standing in orderly array.
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.quote: the room was filled with the mail-clad warriors of the Nome King, rank after rank standing in orderly array.

1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.subject: Nome King
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.statement: The Nome King sat upon his throne of rock in the center of his army.
1907-ozma-of-oz-16-purple-green-and-gold.quote: in the center of this terrible army sat the little King upon his throne of rock.

1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.subject: throne bell
1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.statement: The bell above the Nome King's throne rings whenever an enchantment is broken.
1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.quote: the bell above the throne, which sounded whenever an enchantment was broken, began to ring

1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.subject: Billina
1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.statement: Billina transformed ornaments into living persons.
1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.quote: it announced the fact that Billina had transformed one more ornament into a living person.

1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.subject: Nome King
1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.statement: The Nome King summoned his warriors with a shrill whistle from the balcony door.
1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.quote: he suddenly ran to the little door that opened upon the balcony and gave the shrill whistle that summoned his warriors.

1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.subject: Nome King
1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.statement: The Nome King ordered his captain to seize Dorothy.
1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.quote: "Seize that girl!" shouted the King to his captain, and a group of warriors sprang forward to obey.

1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.subject: Saw-Horse
1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.statement: The Saw-Horse kicked the Nome King with both his wooden hind legs.
1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.quote: the Sawhorse ran up behind him and gave the fat monarch a powerful kick with both his wooden hind legs.

1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.subject: Nome King
1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.statement: The Nome King tried to enchant the Saw-Horse so it could not move.
1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.quote: at once he waved his hand toward the Sawhorse and muttered a magical word.

1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.subject: magic
1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.statement: The Nome King's magic will not work on wood.
1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.quote: Your magic will not work on wood, you know.

1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.subject: egg
1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.statement: Eggs are fatal poison to Nomes.
1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.quote: The warriors fairly tumbled over one another in their efforts to escape the fatal poison of that awful egg, and those who could not rush down the winding stair fell off the balcony into the great cavern beneath, knocking over those who stood below them.

1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.subject: Scarecrow
1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.statement: The Scarecrow hurled one of Billina's eggs at the Nome King and struck him squarely in his left eye.
1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.quote: It struck him squarely in his left eye, where the egg smashed and scattered, as eggs will, and covered his face and hair and beard with its sticky contents.

1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.subject: Scarecrow
1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.statement: The Scarecrow threw the second egg against the Nome King's right eye and blinded him entirely.
1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.quote: before the monarch had managed to clear the egg away from his left eye the Scarecrow threw the second egg against his right eye, where it smashed and blinded him entirely.

1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.subject: Billina
1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.statement: Billina told Dorothy to get the Nome King's jeweled belt.
1907-ozma-of-oz-17-the-scarecrow-wins-th.quote: "Get his belt!  Get the Nome King's jeweled belt!  It unbuckles in the back.  Quick, Dorothy--quick!"
